objective: Investigate the previously observed cold-process post-tuning graph/default gap using retained real-layer graphs and balanced interleaved replay; do not assume a kernel or v2 cause.

flashinfer_source.implementation: Exact original diff applied cleanly to0.7.2, not full PR head; candidate source only for every arm.
flashinfer_source.native_loading: Reuse audited prepare_native(candidate): explicit JitSpec.build/load, identical module bootstrap in every arm; reject AOT substitution. One isolated candidate build workspace, fresh process/container per worker.

environment.hardware_change: Reuse prior H100NVL physical GPU if available; no comparisons to earlier HBM3 absolute timings. Hardware preflight must match this frozen expected model/UUID/driver before workers.

workload.projection: First transformer layer fused q/k/v projection, concatenated in source-verified SGLang QKV loader order.
workload.fixture: Frozen captured BF16 activations and checkpoint weights; per-tensor static scales calibrated from this one input/weight tensor. Exact shapes, tensor/file hashes and capture provenance frozen before tuning workers.
workload.persistence: Existing real SGLang wrapper and v1 JSON save/load; managed store disabled.
workload.shape_limit: One representative captured prefill projection, not full-model output accuracy or traffic distribution. Dense BF16 checkpoint adapted to static per-tensor FP8 for this experiment; no production calibration claim.
workload.path: Actual SGLang static quantizer, normal custom-op dispatch/fast path and allocation, FlashInfer cublas FP8 implementation; no replacement or output copy in timed calls.
workload.profiling_input_limit: Actual serving and startup calls use captured BF16 inputs quantized by SGLang. FlashInfer retains its existing synthesized dynamic FP8 activation profiles; static real QKV weights and scales are reused. Reset RNG19 does not mean synthesized profiling activations equal captured serving activations. No activation-domain fidelity or profiling-policy change is claimed.

protocol.trial_order: Ascending0..5, balanced v1/v2 order; each worker fresh process and private initially empty cache. Separate observation subprocesses run after every timing worker.

graphs.pre_default: Captured before startup tuning under genuine default miss, retained through startup and every subsequent capture/replay.
graphs.post_hit: Captured after actual cold wrapper tuning consumes naturally selected winner from memory.
graphs.post_miss: Captured after tuning with actual winner/file maps reversibly removed; real lookup must miss and choose-1. Natural state restored before replay.

protocol.post_capture_order: post_hit/post_miss for even trial IDs, reverse for odd trial IDs.
history_windows: same retainedpregraph immediately after startup before new captures
three graphs after all captures sequentially
protocol.block_order: All six permutations of three graphs repeated four times, deterministic seeded shuffle. Identical common5120replays pergraph in everyblock.
protocol.timing: Raw CUDAGraph.replay only; primary GPU event span, wall channel retained. No output rebinding/copy, Python/native observer, subprocess query or profiler in timed spans. GPU event span may include host-submission gaps.
protocol.numerical_guards: Actualgraphowned output rebound after untimed replay, poisoned output and zero/restored BF16 input; quantized-input FP32 numerical gate and separate BF16 approximation diagnostic.
protocol.instrumentation: Timing workers forbid native preload/torchprofiler; separate explicit observe-mode constructor guard adapter retains actual LD_PRELOAD interposition, native algorithm bytes/settings and actual graph replay launch traces, never latency estimates.
protocol.checkpoint: First two timingworkers trial0 must pass frozen analyzer before remaining10. Finaltiming gate precedes twoobservers; finaloverall gate requires observations. No performance acceptance threshold.
protocol.startup_scope: Secondary wrapper-only diagnostic excludes model capture/native construction/build/load/initialquantizer and graphpreparation. Preserve unspecified policy and normal synthesized profiler activations.

acceptance: Frozen clean source, original runtime source overlay, exact existing fixture/model provenance, expected physicalH100/image/driver, actual explicitnative build/load match.
Real v1/v2 startup profiling is finite; every chosen runtime bucket winner is a profiler minimum. V2default participates; never force it to win. Startup alone mayprofile.
All three graphs retain their actual normal output allocations, share frozeninputs and execute correctly under outputpoison and changed/restoredinputs.
pre_default and post_miss actualsearch tier miss/default-1; post_hit actualmemorywinner, explicitdescriptor accepted natively ifselected.
Actualcache controls restore entiremapcontents and natural persistedcachebytes, including everyunrelated entry; correct callerstream/tuning/store state afterstartup/controls.
Zero profiling outside coldstartup, no managedstore or explicitmeasurementpolicy, no performanceinstrumentation in timingworkers.
Balanced block orders/commonreplaycounts, valid raw event/wall observations and perwindowclock/power context recorded; allfailure/retryattempts preserved.
Separate observeworkers produce nativealgorithm and actualCUDA launch evidence for allgraphs; do not infer samekernel from publictactic alone.

analysis.independent_unit: Six freshprocess trials perarm on fixedcapturedlayer; pairedblocks and15samples are dependent subsamples, not independenttrials.

comparisons.capture_history: post_miss/pre_default within interleavedblocks aftertuning; both publicdefault-1 with independentcaptures.
comparisons.cached_winner: post_hit/post_miss in interleavedblocks; compare samepublic-1 in v2 onlywhere naturalwinner-1, explicitv1 separate comparator.
comparisons.sequential_vs_interleaved: Report separately to quantify window/order dependence; never replace one estimand with another.

analysis.uncertainty: Worker medianofwithinblockratios, then sixtrialmedians/ranges/wincounts and exact wholetrialbootstrap95% exploratoryunadjusted intervals. No general serving performanceclaim.
analysis.interpretation: Retainedpregraph changes suggest process/windowhistory; differences between retainedgraphs in same interleavedwindow suggest capture/allocation/algorithm effects. Nativeandtrace observations are separate subprocesses and cannot prove actualtimingkernelidentity; report scope.
analysis.scope_limits: One frozenactual FP8 layer and unpublished descriptoroverlay; no fullserver throughput, dependencyreleasequalification, managedstore or policyadoption.
analysis.history_control_limit: No separate untuned process with matched elapsed workload is run; chronological before/after changes do not uniquely establish tuning as their cause. Retainedgraphs and interleaving distinguish stable capture-specific gaps from observed process/window changes.
analysis.protocol_change_limit: This deliberately retained-graph/capture-allocation protocol differs from the earlier separate default/v1/v2 processes and their eager-before-graph windows. Disappearance of the gap here cannot uniquely prove the earlier cause or retroactively label it noise.

publication.records: Preserve every attempt, exact raw bytes, numerical/cache/native build evidence, timing samples, neutral/regressive outcomes; one living Markdown for narrative/history.

resource_policy: One exclusive samephysicalH100 allocation at most1hour aftersourcefreeze. Preserve fullprivatebinary/fixture archive with node/durable/download hashagreement before release. No CI trigger or PR.

prior_observation.cause: unresolved; v2/v1 graph ratio was lower, so this is not proof of v2 versus v1 regression.
